# `<e-slider>`

<p><img alt="e-slider screenshot" src="../__tests__/__screenshots__/inputs-slider--default.png" width="480" /></p>

Range slider with a wide grip, printed scale and optional tick marks.

> Source: [slider.ts](./slider.ts)
